_what: How a screen in an AI app asks again for a read it already holds (src/view-patch.mjs, used by src/screen-view.mjs and src/workspace/screen-view.tsx). The screen names the identity of the answer it holds (`have`, the BLAKE3 of its text); when the Worker still holds that same answer for that person and path, it sends only the changes (a patch) if the patch is smaller than `patch_share` of the whole answer, otherwise the whole answer. The Worker keeps at most `entries` answers per isolate, none longer than `most_chars` and none for answers shorter than `least_chars` (a short answer is cheaper whole). A cache miss, a different identity or a body that is not JSON always answers the whole text, so a patch is an optimisation and never changes what the screen shows.

words.mismatch: The patched answer did not match its identity, so the whole answer was read again.
